timeline.text: Watch an old clip of mine and something feels off.
The picture had a fixed length, so when the voice ran longer, it just looped — you'd see the same scene twice while the words moved on.
So I flipped it. Now I write the narration first and measure each sentence.
The video, built in Remotion, follows those exact measurements, beat by beat.
This clip now runs exactly nine hundred seven frames — precisely as long as the voice needs.
